meta.age_note: Advantage+ lets the hard age minimum go no higher than 25. To enforce 30+, switch to original audience (Advantage+ off) or use 25 as control + age suggestion. Default: control 25, suggestion = segment age range; review age breakdown weekly and move to original audience if >20% of spend goes below segment age_min.
meta.income: No reliable US household-income targeting; the ZIP list is the income filter.
meta.special_ad_category: None for home services. Declare Financial Products only if the ad is about a loan or credit offer itself.

google_search.location: zip_list_or_radius, presence only (people in or regularly in)
google_search.demographics_mode: observation first; bid adjustments after 30 conversions
google_search.income_note: Top 50% starts near the US median household income ($83,730 in 2024). A $70K floor sits inside 'Lower 50%', so never exclude Lower 50% or Unknown on Search; use bid adjustments.
google_search.detailed_demographics: Homeowners (observe or target); exclude Renters only where segment allows

platform_rules.google_lsa: No demographic targeting: service area (ZIPs) and job types only. ZIP scoring decides the service-area list.
platform_rules.pmax_demand_gen: Audience signals: customer list, website visitors, Homeowners detailed demographic, in-market home services segments.

never_use: race, ethnicity, religion or other protected traits

segments.name: Bill savings (lease/PPA or financed)
segments.zip_filters: high utility rates; net metering available; roof age under 15 yrs or bundle re-roof; low tree cover
segments.meta: Advantage+ on; suggestion 35-65; qualifying lead form (owner, utility, bill, roof age)
segments.google: Search: solar panels [city], solar lease; observe Homeowners; exclude Renters

segments.name: Battery / backup
segments.google: Search: solar battery, home battery backup
